messages:
sam: heads up — alert: alerthub outbound splay retries spiking, pages aren't being delivered to notify-bridge, seen in eu-prod and us-west.
maria: omg, I see the same in the dashboard. error rate 502->429 chain and then 'handshake orphaned' in the logs.
inc-assistant: IncidentAssist detected 12 failed deliveries in 3m, suppression triggered for channel #ops-pager. Auto-escalation suppressed.
ops-bot: automated note: suppress_window_entered by pattern alerthub/retry-loop at 2026-03-19T22:04:13Z :no_entry_sign:
jordan: can someone post the raw error snippet? need to triage if this is signing or header truncation.
sam: log excerpt:
```
WARN alerthub.outbound: handshake timeout to notify-bridge (tcp reset) code=EPIPE retries=3 splay=0.12
ERROR notify-bridge: received malformed-signature header: len=0
```
maria: interesting — signature header len=0 looks like a proxy dropped headers during chunked splay. PR that touched header-chunking rolled yesterday.
oncall-aaron: i'm oncall, jumping in. do we need to page DB/infra? or is this pure infra-proxy? :eyes:
sam: starting manual paging now because incident-assistant suppression prevented the usual pages. paging: @oncall-aaron @pager-escalation
inc-assistant: manual page recorded by sam at 2026-03-19T22:07:01Z — note: auto-retry still active but not delivering.
jordan: quick mitigation idea — flip alerthub to passthrough signing (disable header compress) and force notify-bridge to accept legacy-sign header. can one of infra apply temporary config?
maria: i'll open a limited rollback of header-chunking on canary first. rolling to eu-prod will take ~3m.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: starting rollout alerthub@rollback/header-chunking (canary: eu-prod) — 1/3 hosts
sam: while that runs, can we re-enable incident-assistant pages to avoid missed handoffs? it suppressed because of the repeating failures.
inc-assistant: I cannot re-enable auto-pages while suppression flag active. request a manual override with reason text: "manual-override - ongoing outage, auto-suppression unsafe".
oncall-aaron: override granted. doing manual override now.
ops-bot: action: incident-assist override applied by oncall-aaron — auto-pages resumed.
jordan: canary rollback succeeded on eu-prod canary. errors dropped to zero. initiating gradual rollout to remaining hosts.
maria: rolling remainder — notify-bridge ack now normal on eu and us-west. monitoring 5m.
sam: confirming: customers showing transient 502s, but no persistent page deliveries failing now. any customer impact noted by support?
oncall-aaron: support pinged: two customers reported delayed webhooks and one missed SLA notify — CS ticket created #CS-1429. flagging for postmortem.
jordan: root cause will likely be header compression/chunking regression + splay timing exposing proxy edge case. follow-up: add unit test for empty signature header and a health-check that verifies header passthrough across proxy.
maria: agree. temporary mitigation steps recorded in playbook. will draft a postmortem and link the manual override timeline.
sam: thanks everyone — leaving notes and will close thread after 1h stable. :thumbsup:
